questions.question: The inner circumference of a circular track is 1408 m and the track is 7 m wide. The cost of levelling the track at Rs. 6 per m² is: (Take π = 22/7)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Inner circumference of a circular track is 1408 meters 

Track is 7 m wide

Cost of levelling a track at Rs. 6 per m²

**Formula Used:**

Circumference = 2πr

Area = πr² 

Where,

r is radius

**Calculation:**

Inner circumference = 2πr

⇒ 1408 = 2 × 22/7 × r

⇒ r = (1408 × 7)/(2 × 22)

⇒ r = 224 meters

Inner radius of circular track (r) = 224 meters

options.text: B's income is more than A's income by 11(1)/(9)%
A's income is less than B's income by 11(1)/(9)%

Income of A and B is 180x and 100x respectively

⇒ [(160x - 144x)/144x ] × 100 =** **111over9%

**∴ B's Income is more than A's income by 111over9%**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** **Given:**

A's income is 80% more than B's income

**Calculation:**

Let B's income be Rs. 100

A's income,

⇒ B's income + 80% of B's income

⇒ 100 + (80/100 × 100)

⇒ 180

Now A's income is decreased by 20%

⇒ 180 – (20/100) × 180

⇒ 180 – 36

questions.question: The average of 16 numbers is 68.5 If two numbers 54 and 37 are replaced by 45 and 73 and one more number x is excluded, then the average of the numbers decreases by 1.5. The value of x is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Average × Number = Sum

⇒ 68.5 × 16 = 1096

According to question

Then, 54 + 37 = 91 and 45 + 73 = 118

91 replaced by 118 So, 118 - 91 = 27 and 

⇒ 1096 + 27 = 1123 and after that x excluded

New Sum = 1123-x ---(i)

New average is 68.5 - 1.5 = 67

⇒ 67 × 15( number) = 1005 ( new sum) ---(ii)

From (i) & (ii) equal 

⇒ 1005 = 1123 - x 

⇒ x = 118

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** 

**Given:**

Average of 16 numbers is 68.5

54 and 37 are replaced by 45 and 73

**Concept Used:**

Average = Sum of all observations/Total number of observations

**Calculation:**

Sum of all observations = Average × Total number of observations

⇒ Sum of all observations = 68.5 × 16

⇒ Sum of all observations = 1096

54 and 37 are replaced by 45 and 73

⇒ 54 + 37 = 91 replaced by 45 + 73 = 118

91 is replaced by 118, and one more number, i.e. x is excluded

⇒ 118 – 91 = 27 is added to the total sum and x is excluded

New Sum = 1096 + 27 – x

⇒ New Sum = 1123 – x,

The average is decreased by 1.5

New average = 68.5 – 1.5

⇒ New average = 67

Total numbers = 16 – 1

⇒ Total numbers = 15

New sum of all observations = 67 × 15

⇒ New sum of all observations = 1005

⇒ x = New Sum –Sum

⇒ x = 1123 – 1005

⇒ x = 118

**∴ The value of x is 118.**

questions.question: The market price of an article is Rs. 640. A trader earns 20% profit when he sells it at a discount of 40% on its market price. The cost price of the article is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** MP = Rs 640

According to question

Let the Cost price (CP) be 100x 

SP = 120x ( Profit 20%)

then, Discount of 40% on MP means ∵ [Let the MP = 100 & SP = 60]

MP - Discount = SP

So, MP = (120x) × 100/60 = 200x

Now, 200x → Rs 640 (given)

⇒ 100x → ?

CP = (100x) × 640/200x = **Rs.320**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** 

**Given:**

Marked price of an article is Rs. 640

Earns 20% profit when offers 40% discount on MP.

**Concept Used:**

SP = (100 – D%)/100 × MP

Profit = SP – CP

Where,

SP is Selling price

CP is cost price

MP is marked price 

**Calculation:**

SP = (100 – 40)/100 × 640

⇒ SP = 60/100 × 640

⇒ SP = 6 × 64

⇒ SP = 384

Now profit % is 20%

20% = 1/5

⇒ Profit% = (1 + 5)/5

⇒ Profit% = 6/5,

where 6 is SP and 5 is CP,

Now comparing,

6 = 384

⇒ 1 = 384/6

⇒ 1 = 64

5 = 5 × 64

⇒ 5 = 320

**∴ The cost price of an article is Rs. 320**

questions.question: Pipes A and B can fill a tank in 20 hours and 30 hours respectively, whereas pipe C alone can empty the full tank in 10 hours. Pipes A and B are opened together for 3(1)/(2) hours and then closed. If pipe C is opened, It will empty the tank in:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Pipe A in 20 hours. 

Pipe B in 30 hours.

Pipe C empty in 10 hours.

Pipe A and B are opened for 3(1)/(2)hours.

**Formula Used:**

Efficiency × Time taken = Total capacity of tank

Total capacity of tank = LCM of time taken

**Calculation:**

Total capacity of tank, 

⇒ LCM of 20, 30, and 10

⇒ 60

Total capacity of tank is 60 units.

Efficiency of Pipe A = 60/20

⇒ Efficiency of Pipe A = 3 units/hour.

Efficiency of Pipe B = 60/30

⇒ Efficiency of Pipe B = 2 units/hour.

Efficiency of Pipe C = 60/10

⇒ Efficiency of Pipe C = 6 units/ hour

Pipe A and B opened for 3(1)/(2)hours.

⇒ Combine efficiency of A + B,

⇒ 3 + 2 

⇒ 5 units/hour

3(1)/(2)hours = 7/2 hours

⇒ 5 × 7/2

⇒ 35/2 units filled 

Now Pipe C will work,

It will empty the 35/2 units in,

⇒ Time = (35/2)/6

⇒ Time = 35/12

⇒ Time = 2frac{{11}}{{12}}

⇒ Time = 2 hours and 55 minutes.

**∴ Pipe C will empty the tank in 2 hours and 55 minutes.**

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 10,240 amounts to Rs. 14,848 in 3 years at simple interest at a certain rate percent per annum. The same sum will amount to Rs. x in 1(1)/(4) year at the rate, if the interest is compounded five-monthly. The value of x is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Rs. 10,240 amounts Rs. 14,848 in 3 years

**Formula Used:**

For Simple interest, 

A = P + SI

SI = (P × N × R)/100

A is Amount,

SI is simple interest,

P is Principle,

N is total number of years

R is rate

For Compound interest,

A = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ

A is Amount,

P is Principle,

R is rate,

N is total number of years

**Calculation:**

Interest = Amount – Principle

⇒ Interest = 14,848 – 10,240

⇒ Interest = 4,608

SI = (P × N × R)/100

⇒ 4,608 = (10,240 × 3 × R)/100

⇒ R = (100 × 4,608)/(10,240 × 3) = 15%

Now the same compounded five monthly for 1(1)/(4) year

The new rate,

⇒ R' = 15 × 5/12

⇒ R' = 25/4%

New time,

⇒ 1/4 × a year

⇒ 1/4 × 12 months = 3 months

When compounded annually,

⇒ A = 10,240(1 + (25/4)/100)³

⇒ A = 10,240(1 + 25/400)³

⇒ A = 10,240(1 + 1/16)³

⇒ A = 10,240(17/16)³

⇒ A = 10,240 × 17/16 × 17/16 × 17/16

⇒ A = 12,282.50

**∴ The amount when Componded is Rs. 12,282.50**

questions.question: Let x be the number which when divides 988, 1637 and 2345, the remainder in each case is the same. The remainder is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The three numbers are 988, 1637, and 2345.

**Concept Used:**

HCF of big numbers is equal to the HCF of their differences.

**Calculation:**

1637 – 988 = 649

2345 – 1637 = 708

2345 – 988 = 1357

Now the HCF of 649, 708, and 1357 is,

⇒ 649 = 59 ×
; 11

⇒ 708 = 59 × 12

⇒ 1357 = 59 × 23

The HCF of above three numbers is 59.

If we divide 988, 1637, and 2345 by HCF we will get same reminder.

⇒ 988/59, then the reminder is 44.

⇒ 1637/59, then the reminder is 44.

⇒ 2345/59, then the reminder is 44.

**∴ The common reminder in each case is 44.**

questions.question: Rina's expenditure is 300% more than her savings. If her income increased by 30% and savings increased by 20%, then by what percentage does her expenditure increase?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let **Savings** = 1 unit.

**Expenditure** = 1 + 300% of 1 = 4 units.

**Income** = Expenditure + Savings = 4 + 1 = 5 units.

Using **Net Deviation**: Increase in (**Exp** × %E) + (**Sav** × %S) = **Inc** × %I

(4 × %E) + (1 × 20) = 5 × 30 ⇒ 4 × %E = 150 − 20 = 130 ⇒ %E = 32.5%.

**∴ The correct answer is 32.5%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fee8d3d78259f6cf8d99905d40bbd829eb2ec9bf54864a050f6831c0f1f3a223.png] 

**Given:** Expenditure is 300% more than savings.

⇒ Let **Initial Savings** = ₹100

⇒ **Initial Expenditure** = 100 + (300% of 100) = ₹400

⇒ **Initial Income** = 400 + 100 = ₹500

⇒ **New Income** (30% increase) = 500 × 1.30 = ₹650

⇒ **New Savings** (20% increase) = 100 × 1.20 = ₹120

⇒ **New Expenditure** = New Income − New Savings = 650 − 120 = ₹530

⇒ **Increase in Expenditure** = 530 − 400 = ₹130

⇒ **Percentage Increase** = (130 ÷ 400) × 100 = 32.5%

**∴ The correct answer is 32.5%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income-Expenditure Relation

Income is the sum of Expenditure and Savings. **Income = Expenditure + Savings**.

Percentage Increase Shortcut

Percentage Change = (Final Value − Initial Value) ÷ Initial Value × 100.

Weighted Average in Income

Income % change = (Exp Ratio × Exp % change + Sav Ratio × Sav % change) ÷ Total Ratio.

questions.question: When x is subtracted from each of 43, 38, 11 and 10, the numbers so obtained in this order, are in proportion. What is the mean proportional between (5x + 1) and (7x + 4)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For numbers a, b, c, d, the value x subtracted to make them proportional is given directly by x = (ad − bc) ÷ ((a + d) − (b + c)).

Here, x = (43 × 10 − 38 × 11) ÷ ((43 + 10) − (38 + 11)).

x = (430 − 418) ÷ (53 − 49) = 12 ÷ 4 = 3.

Substitute x = 3 to find the given terms: (5 × 3 + 1) = 16 and (7 × 3 + 4) = 25.

Mean proportional = √(16 × 25) = 4 × 5 = 20.

**∴ The correct answer is 20.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The original numbers are 43, 38, 11, and 10.

When x is subtracted from each, the resulting numbers (43 − x), (38 − x), (11 − x), and (10 − x) are in proportion.

**Formula Used:**

If four numbers a, b, c, and d are in proportion, then a : b :: c : d ⇒ ad = bc.

The mean proportional between two numbers A and B = √(A × B).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c731e7914781af2a4b68c4415c7015515b1e3c4e3e16bb5e0e8b7746599b161.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ (43 − x) ÷ (38 − x) = (11 − x) ÷ (10 − x)

⇒ (43 − x)(10 − x) = (38 − x)(11 − x)

⇒ 430 − 53x + x² = 418 − 49x + x²

⇒ 430 − 418 = 53x − 49x

⇒ 12 = 4x

⇒ x = 3

Substitute the value of x = 3 into the given expressions to find the two terms:

⇒ First term = (5x + 1) = 5(3) + 1 = 16

⇒ Second term = (7x + 4) = 7(3) + 4 = 25

⇒ Mean proportional = √(16 × 25)

⇒ Mean proportional = √400 = 20

**∴ The correct answer is 20.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional between two numbers a and b is simply the square root of their product, given by √(a × b).

Third Proportional

If a : b :: b : c, then c is called the third proportional to a and b. It can be directly calculated using the formula c = b² ÷ a.

Fourth Proportional

If a : b :: c : d, then d is the fourth proportional to a, b, and c. It is calculated using the formula d = (b × c) ÷ a.

Componendo and Dividendo

If a ÷ b = c ÷ d, then according to this theorem, (a + b) ÷ (a − b) = (c + d) ÷ (c − d). This rule is extensively used to simplify complex equations involving proportions quickly.
